result.summary: Two visual issues: duplicate restaurant cards in the Fastest carousel and a slightly clipped promo banner.

issues.description: The Fastest near you carousel shows the same restaurant twice in a row (Green Bowl Poké with identical image, time, and delivery fee).
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate carousel items so each restaurant appears only once, or ensure distinct nearby options are shown.

issues.description: The green promo banner’s bottom-right corner is slightly cut off / not fully rounded, so the card edge looks cropped against the page background.
issues.suggestion: Give the banner enough padding or overflow so the full rounded rectangle (including the decorative circle) is visible.
